Author: @ddrsoul

Tested on Anbernic RG DS (RK3566).

### New
- **Yabadabadoo** ([v0.4](https://github.com/ProRapSuperstarOriginalMaster/Yabadabadoo/releases/tag/v0.4)): an additional Sega Saturn core, a YabaSanshiro fork tuned for low-end handhelds, picked per game in EmulationStation (YabaSanshiro stays the default). v0.4 is its speed update: Sega Rally, Daytona USA and Panzer Dragoon run at (almost) full speed without frameskip, and Die Hard Arcade, Fighters Megamix, Virtua Fighter 2 and Shining Force III run much better.

  If a game misbehaves on it, turn off threaded video in RetroArch: the author reports it broken outside the Miyoo Mini for now.
- **mGBA QoL 0.4.0**: the bottom-screen companion now also covers **Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow** (USA) and the **Aria of Sorrow Alter** hack: the explored castle map with Soma's position and map/soul percentages, the enemies in the current room with HP, weaknesses, drops and whether you have their soul, and the full soul list with where each one drops.

### Updated
- **DSperate 3.3.0** (from 3.0.3):
  - GPU 3D: a faster GPU raster, and its compiled pipelines are cached, so it starts in milliseconds after the first run.
  - Anti-aliasing has a third choice in the game settings, **enhanced (gpu 3d)**: a sharper edge cut on the GPU raster. **on** is 4x MSAA there.
  - Slot 2: GBA cartridges for DS games with dual-slot features, the Rumble Pak (the handheld's own motor) and the Guitar Hero Guitar Grip for the On Tour games.
  - Analog Circle Pad patches work out of the box.
  - Fixes: games left on a blank screen after sleep, the DS clock lagging after sleep, a Dragon Quest IX freeze after loading a save state, Zoo Keeper and Picross DS (Korean) boot hangs, shimmering textures on the GPU raster.
